title: Authenticated web and desktop user activity audit

crossYearFixture.description: KST 2025/2026 boundary event dates remain separate; deduplicated retries preserve original received year/day. All ERP business keys and ledgers preserved.

dnspyEvidence.source: Web-only audit journal and read projection; no ERP SQL or native EXE implementation modified. Existing native compatibility evidence remains authoritative and every ERP table is preserved.

privacy: No input values, raw DOM, secrets, URL query/hash, request or response body. Server derives actor from authentication. Source based on UA is display metadata only.
access: All authenticated users record; existing isOrbitReportViewer decides read access. Client visibility is not authorization.
semantics: Click or submission is an attempt. HTTP success alone does not establish committed business changes. NENOVA.EXE is outside collection scope. No retroactive or lossless completeness claim.
retention: No automatic deletion. Actor+event ID deduplication, Linux file/index fsync before acknowledgement. Browser localStorage uses per-account/per-event keys to recover after tab/browser close; blocked/full storage reports errors and retains bounded memory queue. Electron queue encrypted on disk. Server failed HTTP records retry from process-global bounded 1000-event queue every 5 seconds; pending/dropped health remains warning and is exposed by me. Process exit during storage failure can lose this server retry queue; browser storage clearing and disk failure can lose records. Disk/inode health monitored. No lossless claim.
presentation: 1920x1080 CSS pixels at 100%; page vertical scroll, table-only horizontal scroll, full label wrapping, native keyboard controls, focus returns to results heading after query; existing ERP history remains intact.
sideEffects: OrderDetail, ShipmentDetail, ShipmentDate, ShipmentFarm, Estimate, StockHistory, WebProfitReport and all ERP ledgers preserved. New storage is web audit only.
coverage: Authenticated web interaction and API logs plus Electron allowed shell commands; generic action correlation covers synchronous event requests, not awaited/delayed handlers. recordedBy identifies server records versus untrusted client metadata. All ERP ledgers preserve; native dnSpy changes not applicable.
